hierarchy.notes: A consent-driven local command center that explains the usage pipeline before connection, then reads aggregate intelligence from a tokenized loopback API without uploading the ledger.

classification.notes: The browser reads aggregate stats and insights from 127.0.0.1 only after an explicit ephemeral-token handshake; it never requests raw records.

ssa_v2.notes: Route composition, dormant guidance, local transport, payload normalization, connected rendering, and styling are isolated and every owned file remains below 400 lines.

ssi.notes: The server route mounts one client cockpit; dormant guidance is view-only and a pure parser validates the loopback JSON boundary before connected rendering.

sstf.notes: Focused route, dormant guidance, payload, token, origin, layout, and adjacent local-tool contracts plus the complete 662-test package suite pass on the current tree.

spe.notes: The route fetches two bounded aggregate payloads, caps provider/day/action rendering, and never requests the raw records endpoint.

srs.notes: Dormant, clipboard, authorization, network, malformed payload, empty-ledger, and connected states are visible and fail closed without fabricated usage.

ssra.notes: Release gate, production build, preview and production deploys, and exact-deploy Playwright passes cover unchanged mobile and desktop guidance plus a centered 2640px two-channel command center at 4K; the previously proven real tokenized local-ledger connection remains intact.

sas.notes: The route has an explicit owned-path manifest and a route-local client boundary.

sva.notes: The ephemeral token is read from the fragment, removed from browser history, kept only in React state, and sent solely to 127.0.0.1.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: Next and React are inherited from the web package; the current dependency audit reports no known vulnerabilities.

sai.notes: Lease, intent, source commit, and touched paths are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The route is a 13-line server surface plus isolated transport/view-model, connected cockpit, dormant-state guide, three responsive stylesheets, and focused tests with no new dependency.

verification.command: focused life test + pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm --dir packages/web build
verification.notes: 13 focused and adjacent tests, 15 control-plane tests, 573 package tests, strict VTRS, TypeScript, CLI and Next builds, deploy 6a55c088bc2a11226db4088f, and a real 48,023-row loopback ledger passed at 1440px and 390px with zero overflow or console errors.

verification.notes: 6 focused and adjacent tests, 15 control-plane tests, 635 package tests, strict VTRS, TypeScript, the 29-route Next build, and Netlify deploy 6a569427623071e7f8ec56de passed. Exact-deploy views at 390x844, 1440x900, and 3840x2160 returned HTTP 200 with zero overflow or browser errors; Scan, Sources, Insights, and Profile destinations also returned 200.

verification.command: focused Life tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm --filter @vibetracker/web build + preview/production Playwright
verification.notes: 7 focused Life tests, 15 control-plane tests, 662 package tests, strict VTRS, TypeScript, and the 30-route Next build passed in an isolated clean worktree. Preview 6a57041f67a1ecc88217be07 and production 6a57051d69d3dda5b2308827 prove unchanged 390px mobile and 1440px desktop layouts plus a centered 2640px 4K command center with aligned 1180px and 1442px channels, zero horizontal overflow, zero console errors, zero failed requests, and intact aggregate-only loopback messaging.

install_steps: Confirm every displayed command against CLI help.
Run the focused test and release gate.
known_traps: Never request /records from the hosted dashboard.
Never persist the ephemeral loopback session token.
Connection and payload failures must remain visible to the user.

verification.notes: Current-tree gates and hosted visual proof passed.

created_by.summary: Declared the compact AI Life practice route as an explicit project brick.
created_by.intent: Keep whole-practice usage guidance clear without restoring the former oversized theatre.
created_by.decision_rationale: A server route, route-local copy component, route-local CSS, and one contract test are the minimum responsible boundary.
